flavor_text: Lost to time, this scepter was eventually recovered by ogre magi and put to use in combat. It improves the damage of one's spells and makes him or her less likely to be interrupted while casting them.
tips: This is a one handed club, which uses the two handed club wield animation.. Causes some really weird looking glitches if you equip a shield with it. This seems to be considered a two-handed weapon according to the Power Attack feat, meaning you get a -5 to-hit and a +10 to damage when it is active. This only applies when the Scepter of the Ogre Magi is in your main hand, though it will affect your off-hand weapon damage as well. This was tested using the dropdown in the inventory panel, so playtesting is required. [ Unverified ]
